game_title: Off By One Fixer – Owl Roost Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: In Owl Roost, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the spirit shrine using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The spirit shrine reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the spirit shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
